answer: Census bond: each identity locks 80 credits on a karst plot at a summit. Each epoch a quill-signed record enters the ledger, one key per plot. Auditors replay a random 5% sample of the karst table; a forged record burns the bond and drops its summit slot. First filing 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 80,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented plots fail: quill seals bind each record to its key. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep the bond.
